summary: In February 2026, Goodband was the first of six signers on a Quaker meeting letter calling Israel's actions in Gaza 'genocide' and urging the U.S. to stop funding Israeli military aggression. By lending her name as a lead signer, she publicly endorsed both the genocide designation and the call to end American military financing of Israel.
